metadata.case_name: HO CHONG PENG v. YUE HIN ENGINEERING CO

plaintiff.occupation_before: Technician (CCTV installer) on a casual basis; various other jobs including waiter, hair stylist, supervisor in a metal factory, costume jewellery assembly, painting and maintenance
plaintiff.occupation_after: Security guard (employed with Urban Property Management Ltd; employment lasted until 7 November 2003)

injuries.description: fracture of the left distal radius.
source: Physical and radiological examination revealed fracture of the left distal radius.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at other specified part of wrist or hand level

injuries.description: signs suggestive of reflex sympathetic dystrophy of the left distal forearm
source: signs suggestive of reflex sympathetic dystrophy of the left distal forearm
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the elbow or forearm

injuries.description: left frozen shoulder / post-traumatic adhesive pericapsulitis of the left shoulder
source: post-traumatic adhesive pericapsulitis of the left shoulder
injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at shoulder or upper arm level

manifestations.description: considerable pain in the left wrist
movement of his left wrist was restricted
pain extended to his left arm and shoulder
mild wasting of the girdle and deltoid muscles
tenderness at the triangular fibro-cartilage area of the wrist
decrease of radio-density of the left wrist and hand compatible with history of reflex sympathetic dystrophy or disuse
unable to lift heavy objects with left hand

treatments_received: admitted to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital on 8 March 2002
operation on 9 March 2002 with close reduction, external fixation and K-wire fixation
physiotherapy (follow-up outpatient physiotherapy; twice weekly from 26 May to 8 November 2002; further physiotherapy in early 2004)
rehabilitation in Kwong Wah Hospital including physiotherapy and occupational therapy for about 6 months
about 10 sessions of acupuncture treatment in Kwong Wah Hospital
treatments_future: further operation recommended by Dr Lam (cost $71,000)
MRI scan to rule out major tears in the triangular fibrocartilage or other soft tissue structures (recommended by Dr Lam)
further course of physiotherapy including strengthening exercises (recommended by Dr Lam)

losses.description: considerable pain and loss of amenities; restricted use of left hand; unable to lift heavy weights and unable to work at heights
